summary: GD Culture Group Ltd entered into an at-the-market issuance sales agreement with Univest Securities, LLC to sell up to $300 million of its common stock from time to time. The sales will be made under an effective S-3 shelf registration statement. The agent will use commercially reasonable efforts to sell shares per transaction notices. This is a routine equity shelf facility, not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from ATM sales.
